## 🔍 The 6-Pillar Quality Checklist
<!-- Check all boxes that apply to your submission -->
- [ ] **1. Layman's Analogy:** Everyday intuition and Hinglish / Real-World ELI5 explanation included.
- [ ] **2. Core Mechanics & Key Points:** Concise breakdown of under-the-hood engine execution and edge cases.
- [ ] **3. Visual Diagram:** ASCII architecture, memory layout, or Mermaid flowchart included.
- [ ] **4. Practical Code Snippet:** Runnable code with **100% line-by-line comments**.
- [ ] **5. Senior Interview Pitch:** Natural, authoritative professional English phrasing provided.
- [ ] **6. STAR Production War Story:** Real-world Situation, Task, Action, and quantified Business/System Metrics included.

## 🛠️ Contributor Verification Checklist
- [ ] I ran the automated link verification script and confirmed **0 broken links**.
- [ ] I updated the relevant `README.md` and `interview-questions/README.md` tables if adding new files.
- [ ] My code adheres to modern language standards (e.g. Next.js 15, Angular 21, React 19, Java 21, Python 3.12).
